verdicts.reason: A breaks up the three flavour chips: Blood Orange and Honey Rosemary float at the top centre at mismatched widths, and Cucumber Mint is stranded bottom-right far from them. The SOLSTICE wordmark has also dropped below the headline, and the left-aligned copy clashes with the centred chips, so the layout looks random. B keeps the chips together but stacks them at mismatched widths and in a new order, centred under left-aligned text, giving it two competing axes. It also puts the wordmark under the headline, crams the headline against the top edge and leaves a cramped central column. B is flawed but more grouped and readable, so it is the less bad of the two.
